caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular plaque with a raised relief design. The plaque is bordered by two vertical cylindrical columns on each side, topped with simple horizontal caps. The central design features a decorative urn or vase with two large, curved handles. From the urn, three stylized flowers extend upward: the central flower is larger and more intricate, while the two flanking flowers have a somewhat closed, bud-like appearance. The entire plaque appears to be rendered in shades of dark brown and muted gray, giving it a metallic and aged look. The drawing is set against a plain off-white background, with the words "FRANKLIN SYRES" printed in small, red letters near the bottom right corner.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
